project.title: XR Rhythm Coach
project.caption: VR wrist handtracking and AI coach platform
project.description: A VR wrist handtracking and AI coach platform that help amateur musicians build polyrhythmic drumming skills. Used a Fast-Fourier Transform approach on wrist coordinate data retrieved from a Meta Quest 3 to analyze user rhythmic stability and accuracy. A UCSB Human-AI Integration Lab research project.
